goal: show me how to type a sentence in Notepad and save it as fox.txt
launch: Remove-Item "$env:TEMP\proof" -Recurse -Force -EA 0; New-Item -ItemType Directory "$env:TEMP\proof" | Out-Null; Get-Process notepad -EA 0|Stop-Process -Force;Start-Process "$env:windir\notepad.exe";Start-Sleep 2;Place 'notepad'

steps.say: Type the sentence in the text area.
Type the file name and press Enter.

check.script: $f="$env:TEMP\proof\fox.txt"; $t=if(Test-Path $f){[IO.File]::ReadAllText($f)}else{'<missing>'}; Write-Output "bytes=$t"; if($t -ceq 'The quick brown fox.'){exit 0} else {exit 1}
